title: Late Train Home
notes: Jazz quartet sample generated with Lyria RealTime. Lyric sections drive the cue names.

lyrics.en:
[Verse 1]
Platform lights are humming low
Last train waiting, nowhere to go
I fold the evening in my coat
And hum the tune we never wrote

[Chorus]
Take me home, late train home
Through the rain and the city glow
Take me home, late train home
Slow enough that I can know

[Verse 2]
Windows fog with every breath
Strangers nod like quiet guests
The conductor dims the car
We are all just passing stars

[Chorus]
Take me home, late train home
Through the rain and the city glow
Take me home, late train home
Slow enough that I can know

[Bridge]
One more station, one more street
Footsteps keeping time with me
Somewhere a kitchen light stays on
Somewhere the night is nearly gone

[Chorus]
Take me home, late train home
Through the rain and the city glow
Take me home, late train home
Slow enough that I can know

[Outro]
Late train home
Late train home
